products.name: Alder Wool Overcoat
products.tagline: Double-faced wool and cashmere, cut long
products.description: An unlined overcoat in double-faced Italian wool with a touch of cashmere, finished by hand so the seams sit flat and clean. Relaxed through the shoulder and cut below the knee, it layers easily over tailoring or knitwear.
features: Dropped shoulder with a relaxed, straight fit
products.material: 90% wool, 10% cashmere. Woven in Biella, Italy.
products.care: Dry clean only. Brush after wear and hang on a shaped hanger.

reviews.author: Hannah W.
reviews.title: The coat I'll keep for a decade
reviews.body: Heavy enough for proper cold, light enough to wear all day. The fabric has a lovely soft hand and the cut is perfect over a chunky knit.

reviews.author: Daniel O.
reviews.title: Beautifully made
reviews.body: Every seam is clean inside, which matters on an unlined coat. I sized down one and it fits exactly as I wanted.

products.name: Hale Waxed Field Jacket
products.tagline: Waxed cotton that ages with you
products.description: A four-pocket field jacket in British waxed cotton that shrugs off drizzle and softens into its own shape over time. Lined in brushed cotton twill with a cord collar for colder mornings.
features: Four bellows pockets with snap closures
products.material: Shell: 100% waxed cotton. Lining: 100% cotton twill.
products.care: Do not wash. Wipe clean with a damp cloth and re-wax once a year.

reviews.author: Marcus L.
reviews.title: Proper outerwear
reviews.body: Survived a wet week in the Highlands without complaint. Already starting to crease in all the right places.

reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.title: Great jacket, stiff at first
reviews.body: It takes a couple of weeks of wear to soften, but that's the point of wax. Runs slightly large.

products.name: Soren Quilted Liner Jacket
products.tagline: A light layer for in-between days
products.description: A collarless jacket quilted in a fine diamond pattern and filled with recycled insulation. Wear it alone on cool days or under a coat when the temperature drops.
features: Snap-front closure with two patch pockets
products.material: Shell: 100% recycled nylon. Fill: 100% recycled polyester.
products.care: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle. Tumble dry low.

reviews.author: Elena R.
reviews.title: Wear it constantly
reviews.body: Perfect spring layer and it fits under my wool coat without bulk.

products.name: Isla Cashmere Crewneck
products.description: A classic crewneck knitted from long-fibre Mongolian cashmere, so it stays soft and resists pilling. Finished with fully fashioned shoulders and ribbed trims that hold their shape.
features: Relaxed fit that sits at the hip
products.care: Hand wash cold with wool detergent and dry flat, or dry clean.

reviews.author: Sophie T.
reviews.title: Softest thing I own
reviews.body: Thicker than most cashmere at this price and it hasn't pilled after a whole winter.

reviews.author: James K.
reviews.title: Bought a second colour
reviews.body: The oatmeal goes with everything. True to size with a relaxed fit.

products.name: Fen Merino Cardigan
products.description: A lightweight V-neck cardigan in extra-fine merino that is warm without bulk. Corozo nut buttons and a slim rib finish keep it looking sharp over a shirt or tee.
products.care: Machine wash on a wool cycle at 30°C. Dry flat.

reviews.author: Clara M.
reviews.title: Office staple
reviews.body: Light enough for heated rooms and smart enough for meetings.

products.name: Moor Fisherman Rollneck
products.description: A heavyweight rollneck in undyed British wool, knitted on hand frames in a traditional Aran cable. Warm, a little rugged and built to be passed down.
products.care: Hand wash cold and dry flat. Air between wears.

reviews.author: Tom B.
reviews.title: Like a wearable blanket
reviews.body: Scratchy for the first week, then perfect. Unbelievably warm on the coast.

products.name: Ellis Oxford Shirt
products.tagline: Heavy Oxford cloth, soft button-down collar
products.description: Our take on the classic button-down, in a heavy Japanese Oxford cloth that softens with every wash. The collar has a gentle roll, and the back has a box pleat.
features: Regular fit with a curved hem
products.material: 100% cotton Oxford cloth, woven in Japan.
products.care: Machine wash at 30°C. Line dry and iron while slightly damp.

reviews.author: Oliver P.
reviews.title: Collar is spot on
reviews.body: The roll on the collar is exactly right. Gets better every wash.

reviews.author: Aisha N.
reviews.title: Great shirt
reviews.body: Lovely heavy cloth. Sleeves run a touch long for me.

products.name: Marlow Linen Overshirt
products.description: A boxy overshirt in heavyweight linen, garment-dyed for a soft, lived-in colour. Wear it open over a tee or buttoned up as a light jacket.
products.care: Machine wash at 30°C. Creases are part of the character.

reviews.author: Luca F.
reviews.title: Summer jacket sorted
reviews.body: Great weight and the colour is lovely in person.

products.name: Aro Pima Cotton Tee
products.description: A mid-weight tee in long-staple Peruvian Pima cotton with a clean, close-fitting collar that won't bacon. Cut straight with a slightly dropped shoulder.
features: Taped neck seam that holds its shape
Straight fit with a slightly dropped shoulder
products.care: Machine wash cold. Tumble dry low or line dry.

reviews.author: Nina G.
reviews.title: Finally, a tee that lasts
reviews.body: Still looks new after months of washing. Bought three more.

products.name: Vela Leather Tote
products.description: A structured tote in full-grain vegetable-tanned leather that develops a rich patina with use. It has an unlined suede interior, a zip pocket and enough room for a laptop and a day's essentials.
products.care: Condition every few months. Keep away from prolonged rain.

reviews.author: Grace H.
reviews.title: Worth the investment
reviews.body: Holds my laptop, notebook and lunch with room to spare. The leather is gorgeous.

products.name: Nell Crossbody Bag
products.description: A small crossbody in pebbled calf leather with an adjustable strap and a magnetic flap. It holds a phone, cards and keys without bulk.
products.material: Pebbled calf leather with a cotton canvas lining.
products.care: Wipe with a soft dry cloth. Store stuffed in its dust bag.

reviews.author: Mei L.
reviews.title: Perfect size
reviews.body: Fits everything I need for an evening out. The oxblood colour is beautiful.

products.name: Rowan Canvas Weekender
products.description: A roomy weekender in waxed cotton canvas with bridle leather handles and trim. It is sized to fit under a plane seat and has a padded shoe compartment.
products.material: Waxed cotton canvas, bridle leather, solid brass hardware.
products.care: Spot clean the canvas. Condition the leather occasionally.

reviews.author: Ben A.
reviews.title: Travel upgrade
reviews.body: Beautifully built. Fits a long weekend's packing easily.

products.name: Orla Gold Hoops
products.tagline: Chunky hoops in recycled gold vermeil
products.description: Tubular hoops with a satisfying weight, made from recycled sterling silver and plated in a thick layer of 18k gold. Hinged closures make them easy to put on.
products.material: Recycled 925 sterling silver with 2.5-micron 18k gold vermeil.
products.care: Avoid water and perfume. Polish gently with a soft cloth.

reviews.author: Zoe C.
reviews.title: Every-day hoops
reviews.body: I haven't taken them off in weeks. No tarnishing so far.

products.name: Sable Signet Ring
products.tagline: Solid sterling silver, made to engrave
products.description: A low-profile oval signet cast in solid recycled sterling silver with a softly brushed finish. The flat face is ready for engraving.
products.care: Polish with a silver cloth. Store in its pouch to prevent scratches.

reviews.author: Sam D.
reviews.title: Solid and simple
reviews.body: Nice weight, and the brushed face looks great. Sizing was accurate.

products.name: Lune Pearl Pendant
products.tagline: A single freshwater pearl on a fine chain
products.description: One baroque freshwater pearl, each slightly different in shape, hung on a fine 18k gold vermeil chain. Adjustable to three lengths.
products.material: Freshwater pearl, 18k gold vermeil over recycled silver.
products.care: Put on last, take off first. Wipe with a soft damp cloth.

reviews.author: Ivy R.
reviews.title: Delicate and lovely
reviews.body: The pearl has a beautiful lustre. Bought one for my sister too.

products.name: Wren Cashmere Scarf
products.description: A generous scarf woven from pure cashmere and brushed for a soft, cloud-like finish. The fringe is hand-twisted, and it is wide enough to wear as a wrap.
products.care: Dry clean or hand wash cold. Dry flat.

reviews.author: Rachel V.
reviews.title: Luxurious
reviews.body: So soft and big enough to double as a wrap on planes.

products.name: Ashby Leather Belt
products.description: A 30 mm belt cut from English bridle leather with a solid brass roller buckle. It is stitched by hand and will outlast a dozen cheaper belts.
products.material: English bridle leather with solid brass hardware.
products.care: Condition occasionally. Unfasten fully when not worn.

reviews.author: Chris E.
reviews.title: Built like a saddle
reviews.body: Stiff at first, but it's the last belt I'll buy. Sizing guide is accurate.

products.name: Cato Acetate Sunglasses
products.description: Softly rounded frames polished by hand from Italian acetate, with polarised mineral glass lenses. They come with a leather case and a cleaning cloth.
products.material: Italian acetate with mineral glass lenses.
products.care: Clean with the included cloth. Store in the case.

reviews.author: Leah J.
reviews.title: Beautiful frames
reviews.body: Lovely quality acetate. They sit a little wide on a narrow face.
